pre_animation: v.gray_amount = v.gray_amount ?? 0.0; v.target_gray = !query.is_in_water ? 1.0 : 0.0; v.step_gray = query.delta_time / 8.0; v.gray_amount = v.gray_amount + math.clamp(v.target_gray - v.gray_amount, -v.step_gray, v.step_gray);
scripts.scaleY: v.target = !query.is_in_water ? 0.1 : 1.0; v.scale_y = v.scale_y ?? 1.0; v.step = 0.9 * query.delta_time / 8.0; v.scale_y = v.scale_y + math.clamp(v.target - v.scale_y, -v.step, v.step); return v.scale_y;
